Build kit for "file upload"

Start from the TEMPLATE, fill it with BLOCKS, and use COMPONENTS only for what is left.
Changing a page you already have? Keep it, and use only the blocks and components.

TEMPLATE
Search matched `file-explorer` by name, but the idea is a part of a page and names no page, so it starts from the app shell. Scaffold it, then put blocks inside it.

name:        shell-top-nav
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Application frame with horizontal navigation only: a centered bar whose items open full-width mega-menu panels, over placeholder content that keeps the entire width.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template shell-top-nav --type page <path>

Install missing dependencies: npm install @heroicons/react@"^2.2.0"

This template uses StyleX. Your project needs a StyleX compiler plugin - see `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs styling-overview` for setup steps.

OTHER TEMPLATES
If the layout is wrong, scaffold one of these instead. All page templates: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template --list --type page

name:        contact-form
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Flat single-column form mixing control types (text, pill toggles, dropdowns, long free-text) landing on one full-width submit.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template contact-form --type page <path>

name:        form-two-column
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Form split into two columns beneath a hero header: inputs on one flank, a persistent context panel opposite that stays put while the fields scroll.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template form-two-column --type page <path>

Keyword search matched these page templates: file-explorer (@astryxdesign/core), contact-form (@astryxdesign/core), form-two-column (@astryxdesign/core).

BLOCKS
Ready-made sections for parts the template lacks. Print one: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template <name>

name:        FileInputBasic
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: A controlled single-file upload with accepted types, a size limit, and helper text.

COMPONENTS
For what the template and blocks do not cover. Read one: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 component <name>

name:        FileInput
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: FileInput provides file upload with optional drag-and-drop support.

name:        Thumbnail
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Thumbnail displays a compact, square preview of an image attachment.
